GEMS GROUPS
Since 2020
SERVICE PROPOSAL & CONTRACT TERMS
Prepared for: ____________________________ Date: ______________
1. About Gems Groups
Gems Groups has been delivering digital growth solutions since 2020. We help businesses
build a strong online presence through technology, creativity and smart marketing – all under
one roof.
2. Our Services
• Digital Marketing: social media management, brand promotion and performance
campaigns.
• Ads Management: planning, running and optimising paid advertising campaigns.
• Software & Website Services: website design, development, hosting support and
ongoing maintenance.
• Artificial Intelligence (AI): AI-powered tools and automation to improve business
efficiency.
• Editing: professional video, photo and graphic editing.
• Content Creation: posts, reels, creatives, captions and campaign material.
3. Website Development & Maintenance
The total website cost is approximately ₹70,000 to ₹1,00,000, depending on the scope of the
project. Website development and maintenance charges are included in the total website
cost, so the client does not need to pay anything separately for them. The website cost is
paid monthly over a 2-year (24-month) contract period.
4. Digital Marketing, Content & Ads
Digital marketing, content creation and ad campaigns are not part of the website cost. These
services are charged monthly, based on the client’s requirements, and the payments
continue for as long as the client uses the services – including after the 2-year website
payment period is completed. The scope for each month is discussed and agreed with the
client in advance.
5. Pricing, Payment & Contract Term

| Item | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Website development & maintenance | Total website cost is approx. ₹70,000 – ₹1,00,000, paid in monthly instalments over 24 months (2 years). Development and maintenance are included – no separate payment. |
| Website payment period | 24 months (2 years). Website payments end after the contract period. |
| Monthly service fee | ₹6,500 – ₹7,000 per month for the total service package |
| Digital marketing, content & ads | Continuing monthly payments, based on the client’s requirements. These continue after the website payment period ends. |
| Early cancellation | If the website contract is cancelled within 1 year, the full website amount is payable (see Section 5) |
• Website payment: The website cost is paid monthly over 2 years (24 months). Once
the 24 months are completed, no further website payment is due.
• Monthly payment: The client pays ₹6,500 to ₹7,000 per month for the total service
package.
• Marketing services: Digital marketing, content creation and ad running payments
continue monthly based on requirements, and are updated as the client’s needs
change.
• Early cancellation: If the client cancels the website contract within 1 year, the client
must pay the full website amount.
• Inclusions: Website development and maintenance are covered by the total website
cost; no additional charges apply for them.
6. Acceptance
By signing below, both parties agree to the services, pricing and terms described in this
document.
For Gems Groups Client
